_about: The game runner must never stare: replays the sequence that once froze a 35-build batch (a roads build on a grid block failed (strict-grid builds nothing) 'nothing materialized' and left the preview pending for good, every later scenario waited 60 s on it), then a normal park build, then a strip mall too small to build (its greyed-out Build button must be reported at once, not after a 2-minute ghost wait). Send with: powershell -File tools/suite/Send-Suite.ps1 -File suite/scenarios/stuck-check.json -Build -Who stuck-check
